title: Localized tensor comparison as a derived arrow functor
statement: Let R, A, B and C be commutative rings in a universe u, with R-algebra structures on A and B, and an E-algebra structure on C, where E=A tensor_R B. Assume derived categories of R-, A- and B-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let F be termwise extension from A along A to E to C. Let Q be an A-K-flat cochain complex, N any C-cochain complex, and t:F(Q) to N a chain map. Assume C is flat over E. For each integer i there exists a functor H:D(A) to Arrow(ModuleCat C) such that for every A-K-flat complex U and every base-derived tensor cohomology model mU of U tensor_A Q [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model], the arrow mU.localizedComparison(i) followed by H^i(mu_F(U,Q) inverse followed by identity of F(U) tensor t) is isomorphic in the arrow category to H(Q_A(U)). Here Q_A is the localization functor, and mu_F is the monoidal scalar-extension isomorphism as used in [def-pc-localized-tensor-comparison-property]. No retract, comparison invertibility or hypothesis on N is assumed.

source.place: Tag 06Y6 (derived change of rings), Tag 0BYJ (functorial tensor rebracketing), and perfect.tex Tag 0DJ7 (equation-bc), used by Tag 0DJA(1)

proof.text: Use the canonical model m(U)=baseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (U tensor Q) C. Apply lem-pc-kflat-localized-tensor-comparison-natural to obtain S and eta:S to T on the category of K-flat A-complexes, source inversion, and its component realization for these canonical models.

Convert the acyclic-tensor and categorical K-flat predicates with the existing proved private CochainComplex.kFlat_of_acyclic_tensor, accessed by import all KFlatScalarExtensionDerivedIso. The local private acyclic_tensor_of_kFlat proves the reverse implication directly from the homotopy-category acyclic criterion. Scalar extension preserves K-flatness by lem-pc-kflat-extension-of-scalars and preserves quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes by the existing proved private CochainComplex.scalarExtension_quasiIso_of_kFlat in the same imported module. Apply MorphismProperty.whiskerRight_of_kFlat over C to tensor the extended quasi-isomorphism with arbitrary N, then homology in degree i is invertible. This proves target inversion without any K-flat hypothesis on N.

Construct G(U)=Arrow.mk(eta.app U), mapping a to Arrow.homMk(S.map a,T.map a,eta.naturality a). Arrow.hom_ext and the two functor laws prove its functor laws. Source and target inversion imply G inverts the restricted quasi-isomorphisms by Arrow.isIso_of_isIso_left_of_isIso_right.

Take the existing reduced functorial flat resolution for ModuleCat A. Its kFlatResolutionNatTrans is a quasi-isomorphism augmentation. The source-library isLocalizedEquivalence_of_functorial_left_resolutions proves the K-flat inclusion is a localized equivalence; LocalizerMorphism.IsLocalizedEquivalence.isLocalization identifies its composite L with DerivedCategory.Q as a localization. Exact integer-indexed colimits follow by the AsSmall equivalence, and tensor-right colimit preservation supplies the ambient resolution hypotheses. Localization.lift G hG L and Localization.fac give H on D(A) and L followed by H naturally isomorphic to G. This is actual Lean code, not a new holed descent statement.

For an arbitrary model mU of U tensor Q apply the proved localized model-independence theorem to mU and the canonical m(U). Its s satisfies s.hom followed by m(U).localizedComparison=mU.localizedComparison. Compose s with the canonical source realization e, and use the identity target isomorphism. Category.assoc, the component equation, and the independence equation give the Arrow.isoMk square. Compose this arrow isomorphism with the inverse component of Localization.fac to obtain the requested isomorphism with H(Q(U)). Every existing binder and conclusion is unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_localizedTensorComparison_derived_arrow
    (hQ : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V Q (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic) (i : ℤ) :
    ∃ H : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) ⥤ Arrow (ModuleCat.{u} C),
      ∀ (U : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ),
      (∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
        (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V U (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic) →
      ∀ mU : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (U ⊗ Q) C,
      let F := (extendScalars.{u, u, u}
        ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)
      Nonempty (Arrow.mk (mU.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso F U Q).inv ≫ (F.obj U ◁ t)) i) ≅
          H.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj U))
